column1: # catalog/review-e2e-ratchet.tsv — the lead review's E2E ratchet (BH-7941).
# Read by rl_line_e2e_ratchet in bin/lib/review-level.sh, lens lead only.
# Tab-separated: kind, ere, note. grep -iE. Lines that start with # are comments.
# Edit this file, not the regexes in code.
#   e2e-context        the finding is about a browser E2E test
#   e2e-preexisting    the finding says the failure is red on main too. Each
#                      phrase is anchored: `main` ends at a word end (not
#                      main-merge), a main-run phrase names its result in
#                      the 60 characters after `run`, in the same sentence,
#                      and every phrase names main or the nightly: a bare
#                      `already failing` or `pre-existing failure` is not
#                      proof the failure is red on main, so it stands.
#   e2e-evidence-form  the finding asks for "N full runs" or a per-spec table
#                      A phrase alone never demotes: rl_cap also needs every
#                      spec file the line names in the measured pre-existing
#                      list of `## Main E2E` (bin/lib/review-level.sh
#                      _rl_e2e_all_preexisting), and no weakened test.
#   e2e-keep           the finding stands whatever the two above say (a
#                      regression, a negation, a deleted/skipped test, a
#                      weakened test: fixme, retries, continue-on-error,
#                      comment out). Read on the text AFTER the severity tag,
#                      on both branches. `|| true` is in the weakened-test row
#                      of review-always-block.tsv, which both branches also
#                      read (third lead review of #8142).
#   e2e-head-red       the finding says the head itself fails (a red run, a
#                      failing spec, a dead flow). Read on the evidence
#                      branch only: an ask for "N full runs" or a per-spec
#                      table on top of a real failure is not a demotable
#                      evidence nit, so the line stands (lead review of
#                      #8142). Not read on the pre-existing branch, where
#                      "fails on the head; also fails on main" is the point.
#   e2e-names-run      the finding names a run id of 3+ digits ("run 5001");
#                      "run 3 full runs" is an ask, not a run id.
#                      Read on the evidence branch only, with a spec file
#                      path (_rl_e2e_specs): an evidence ask that names a
#                      spec file or a run is about one concrete result, so it
#                      stands whatever words it uses. Only an ask that names
#                      neither ("no per-spec table", "one run, not 3") is a
#                      demotable evidence nit (second lead review of #8142:
#                      the e2e-head-red words alone were a denylist).
#   e2e-soft-class     the ALWAYS-BLOCK classes this rule may demote; a tag or
#                      text of any other class keeps the line standing
e2e-context
e2e-preexisting
